install.notes: The card and the clone state no Python requirement (task.json install.python is null). requirements.txt:7-11 installs pyvisa, pyvisa-py, psutil, pyserial and nidaqmx. The clone has no setup.py or pyproject.toml, so alim_seq is importable only when its clone root is on PYTHONPATH (or the process runs from that root); that is a deployment assumption. The upstream package is imported by native.py only on the hardware backend; the gate never installs or imports it.
